*Wörterbuch Romani\-Deutsch\-Englisch für den südosteuropäischen Raum: Mit einer Grammatik der Dialektvarianten*\.
Harrassowitz, Wiesbaden, 1994\.
ISBN 9783447034593\.
The appendix deliberately covers “alte Etyma aus allen Dialekten” of European Romani rather than only the southeastern varieties of the dictionary proper, and cites every word in the shape it carries as a main entry there\. The scanned copy lacks the volume's front matter, so its abbreviation key and transcription description were not available; the source abbreviations used in the lists were resolved from the printed Literaturverzeichnis\.

Every printed entry in those lists is represented. Excludes the A--Z Romani-German-English dictionary (pp. 1--310), the German-Romani and English-Romani reverse indexes (pp. 339--362), the Variantengrammatik (pp. 363--417) and the Literaturverzeichnis (pp. 417--418). The “s. X” cross-reference lines inside the lists are pointers to a full entry elsewhere in the same appendix and are recorded in the audit rather than installed as forms
